title: A7-RT Subagent Return Validation Rules
description: Role-based field validation schemas for subagent returns

builder.description: Builder must return node_id and status

test_author.description: Test author must return node_id and test_script

analyst.description: Analyst must return query and verdict

builder.description: Builder node_id and status must be non-null

test_author.description: Test author node_id must be non-null (test_script can be null)

analyst.description: Analyst query and verdict must be non-null

role_descriptions.test_author: Writes test scripts for builder nodes
